mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (historical 20th percentile), or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market characterized by rising nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals potential wage inflation and imminent Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a housing market expansion (HOUST above its 12-month moving average) signals overbuilding and potential bubble formation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS growth > 0.3% MoM) signals robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.3% MoM, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals weakening manufacturing activity and an early-stage economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a demand-side disconnect, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% QoQ) coupled with weak retail sales (RSAFS growth < 0.2% MoM) signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 1.0% QoQ and RSAFS growth < 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% QoQ and RSAFS growth is below 0.2% MoM, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a month, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.
